name: complaints-agent
description: Answers whether a complaint matches a known pattern, what usually causes it, how it has been resolved before and how often that resolution works. Knows the pattern, not the individual case.

skills.name: Match a complaint to a known pattern
skills.description: Given a complaint description, finds whether it matches a known pattern and returns the root cause, the resolution that has been applied before and the success rate of that resolution.
examples: Customer says the same purchase appears twice

skills.name: Check complaint volume
skills.description: Reports how many cases of a given pattern were recorded in the last thirty days, useful to tell an isolated incident from a systemic issue.
examples: How many customers complained about StreamFlix recently?
